scope: D5 interpretation of image features, without biological or causal attribution

studies.read_level_this_stage: Official IBSI feature specification reviewed for the cited definitions; existing paper citation reused, without claiming a new full-paper review

facts.mean: Arithmetic mean of the included intensity values
facts.standard_deviation: Spread of the included intensity values around their mean
facts.histogram_entropy: Shannon entropy computed from probabilities of discretized intensity bins; no voxel-location term
facts.GLCM_contrast: Probability-weighted squared differences between neighboring discretized gray levels
facts.GLCM_aggregation: Direction aggregation and spatial distance are part of the feature definition

studies.permitted_claim: Distinguish distributional descriptors from a spatial co-occurrence descriptor
studies.limits: No complete IBSI benchmark validation or certification is claimed. Our histogram entropy is not GLCM joint entropy, and our contrast is not neighboring-gray-tone contrast. Reuse the complete pagination 328-338 already verified in Stage27 rather than the truncated historical candidate entry.

studies.read_level_this_stage: Full text reviewed for relevant claims

facts.scope: MRI intensity normalization and feature comparability across prostate, brain and breast imaging datasets
facts.radiomic_evaluation: Compared radiomic feature equivalence across acquisition settings after different normalization methods
facts.finding_used: Radiomic comparability varied with normalization choices and acquisition context

studies.permitted_claim: Normalization choices affected radiomic comparability across acquisition settings, including brain imaging
studies.limits: Different images, software and feature definitions; not validation of our percentile transform or eight-feature panel. Do not infer that every feature changes under every normalization, that affine scaling necessarily changes our ROI-range fixed-bin-number texture values, or that the study establishes a cellular mechanism or tumor-change diagnostic performance. No inconsistent aggregate sample or feature counts from the article are reused.

own_study_claims.claim: Eight fixed descriptors use mean, population standard deviation, 32-bin histogram entropy and 3D merged symmetric GLCM contrast for two sequences
ROI is the union of all positive supplied annotation labels, not a mapped histological compartment
Mean and standard deviation use image-specific unclipped percentile-scaled values; histogram and GLCM use ROI-range discretization
Spatial units of supplied files are unknown and the texture offsets are defined on the supplied voxel grid
Coefficients belong to a penalized multivariable diagnostic model; the analysis does not establish independent risk factors, causation or a specific cellular mechanism

interpretation: The favorable primary paired comparison supports a collective predictive signal within this dataset; it does not identify the biological meaning or independent contribution of each feature
